  > 
  > Points I could not settle from the code alone:
  > 1. K = 128 = 4 demo sets (none, A, B, C of 3 demos) × 2 labellings × 8 instruction wordings × 2 cues; scoring = argmax letter log-prob over valid options. Demo items are excluded from S and truth.

  > 4. Max-t: q = (1−α) quantile of max_k Z*_k/se_k with se_k from the item-level column SD (multiplier bootstrap, B=500), lower bound = ybar − q·binomial se(ybar). Candidate sets: evaluated (survivors for SH) and declared (K).
  > 5. "Search-log predictor" = E max Z* (equal-θ upper end) and the refined (EB-shrunk, parametric bootstrap); K_eff from Blom inversion of κ.
  > 6. Semi-synthetic arm (C7) and the leakage counterfactual are not described yet: tell me when their code lands so I write them.
  > Also: which results files and which final-draw counts (draws, bootstrap replicates) will be the delivered ones?
